propositions: CPython 3.12+ warns when fork is used in multithreaded processes, and Python 3.14 no longer defaults to fork, causing deprecation warnings in the grounding worker harness which hard-codes fork on POSIX hosts
The harness must switch from fork to spawn as the default multiprocessing context while preserving caller ability to explicitly select fork for legacy/frozen-executable compatibility
Non-importable callables, non-pickleable arguments, and pickling/unpickling failures must map to fail-open RunResult(abstain_reason="other") rather than propagate exceptions
Worker callables must be module-level importable names and all arguments, kwargs, and return values must be pickleable to work with spawn
46 of 47 existing lifecycle tests pass under spawn; only the reap-lag test fixture fails due to an unpicklable local closure attached before Process start
